thread:
maria_sales: Quick sync - prospect (regulated fintech) wants BYO-HSM for KEK but use Redwood hosted inference. They insist no plaintext KEKs ever touch our environment. Can we do a key-proxy pattern for the POC?

omar_se: Yes, we can front their HSM. Envelope encryption where CEKs are generated by Redwood but wrapped by the customer's KEK via their HSM proxy. We never persist the unwrapped KEK/CEK bytes.

alice_security: Clarify: do they want HSM-level attestation per unwrap (signed metadata) or just an audit log entry? They mentioned "signed unwrap receipts" in the questionnaire.
maria_sales: Procurement wrote: "Must have per-request signed attestation from HSM and immutable audit trail for 7 years. No silent fallback to vendor keys."

omar_se: Signed receipts ok if their HSM supports it (most do via PKCS#11 or cloud HSM signed responses). We can forward request IDs and store the returned signature blob in our audit logs. Note: storing signatures + metadata triggers retention/crypto key mgmt for logs.

legal_clara: 7-year retention is heavy. We need DPA/legal review for storing customer-signed HSM blobs. Also retention location: EU vs US matters for data residency. Flagging for contracts.

raj_ops: From an ops POV: tradeoffs:
- Rotation frequency: 15m KEK rotation is possible but will dramatically increase unwrap ops and may spike latency.
- Cache: maintain short-lived in-memory CEK cache per node (TTL adjustable). For 15m rotation set TTL < rotation window.
- Cross-node invalidation required on rotate -> additional orchestration complexity.

maria_sales: Customer said 15m ideal, 1h acceptable. They also asked about billing: will we pass HSM vendor per-op costs?

omar_se: Pricing options to propose:
1) Pass-through per-unwrap charge (meter HSM ops, bill monthly)
2) Flat monthly BYO-HSM addon covering expected ops + support
3) Enterprise SOW: include on-demand engineering & runbook fee
Recommend (2) for predictability for them, with opt-in pass-through if ops exceed threshold.

alice_security: Fallback policy: they prohibit silent fallback to our managed keys. We should offer two behaviours in config: (a) strict-fail (return 503 on HSM failures), (b) manual-approve fallback (console button + explicit consent logged). Which do they prefer?
maria_sales: They want strict-fail for production. For POC they may accept manual-approve fallback under documented change control.

raj_ops: POC checklist I propose:
- Confirm HSM vendor API + signing capability (PKCS#11/REST)
- Implement proxy shim that forwards unwrap with correlation-id
- CEK cache with invalidation hook + rotation test harness
- Measure p50/p95 token latency with 15m and 1h rotation
- Create billing metric for unwrap ops
- Draft runbook for HSM outage scenarios

omar_se: I'll spin up a PoC branch and add a minimal shim. Sample config we discussed:

```
key_management:
  mode: byo-hsm-proxy
  hsm:
    endpoint: "https://cust-hsm.payments"
    signing_required: true
    cache_ttl_seconds: 240
    rotation_interval_seconds: 3600
    audit_retain_signed_blobs: true
```

Note: set rotation_interval_seconds=900 for 15m tests.

legal_clara: Please add a note about retention scope and that we will encrypt audit blobs at rest with a service key; customer must approve if they require their own key for logs.

maria_sales: I'll schedule the joint call with their crypto lead for Wed AM. Need a 1-page tradeoff doc for procurement: latency impact, cost model, and audit/retention bullet points. Who can draft?

omar_se: I'll draft the arch + perf notes.

alice_security: I'll draft the security checklist and compliance bullets.

maria_sales: Great. Tagging @deploy-bot to create the PoC ticket and add ETA.

deploy-bot: Created task INF-5021: "BYO-HSM proxy POC + billing proposal" assigned to omar_se, raj_ops. ETA 6d. :white_check_mark:

raj_ops: Will run an initial latency sweep and post numbers here.

maria_sales: Keep updates concise - procurement wants headline numbers and the runbook. Thanks! :thumbsup:
